question: How far away is the closest fast food restaurant when measured from Memory Garden, Baltimore, MD?
sql:
SELECT *, ST_Distance(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.638575 39.300016)',4326)::geography)  AS distance  FROM pois
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
ORDER BY geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.638575 39.300016)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;
